text_block_list.text: The Fan Fest is finally here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The huge crowds of fans visiting campus
bring a
festive mood with them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey! You're Сайленс Судзука! You were so
great at
the Kinko Sho!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Oh, th-thank you very much.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You're running in today's team relay
race, right? I
can't wait!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: Yes, um... Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
She appears a little uncomfortable
having to
interact with people in the
packed crowd.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Honestly, all these fans...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I never know how I should respond to
them.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It seems a lot of fans here today were
particularly
impressed by her
performance at the Kinko Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We walk around the academy grounds a
bit, but
it's not long until we're
completely surrounded.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Watching you run is so inspiring!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text: When's your next race?
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text: Is it true that you like strawberry mochi?
text_block_list.name: Fan D

text_block_list.text: Um... Well... Uh...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I should be getting ready for
the relay.
If you would excuse me!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: She's so cool!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
That's part of what I like about her
though!
text_block_list.name: Fan C

text_block_list.text:
I know, right! She's so stoic and focused
only on
running. That's so cool!
text_block_list.name: Fan D

text_block_list.text:
It seems her fans love her all the more
for her
reticent nature.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Soon afterwards, the relay race is ready
to begin!
The academy's most popular
Umamusume gather
up to participate in
this special event.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Serving as the commentator for the
event is the
martial arts-loving El Condor
Pasa!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's time for a relay caliente! Which team
will take
the prize in today's scorchin'
hot contest of
speed?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The heated competition unfurls. As it
nears the
end, the batons are passed to
each team's
anchors—Эйр Грув and
Сайленс Судзука!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The red team's Эйр Грув has the baton
and
she's running like the wind!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
But she's not alone! Fuji is hot on her
tail, passin'
the baton off to Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's down to the two anchors—Silence
Suzuka, the
Otherworldly Front-Runner,
and Эйр Грув, the
Empress!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Can the red team keep their lead? Or
will the
white team catapult ahead?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: The crowd of spectators goes wild.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And there you have it! Эйр Грув flies
ahead to
the finish line! The relay goes
to the red team!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Good job! You almost had it.

text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Yes... It was close.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Even though I had a slow start... in the
end, Air
Groove's final dash was just too
powerful.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I wish I could have taken the lead.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I almost feel like I should
apologize to
everyone...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Well... Because there are so many
people who
came to see me win.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Why do you look so surprised?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: It's nothing. Next time, you'll win!

text_block_list.text: Yes. Next time, without a doubt.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Que rápido! The white team might have
the upper
hand! They pass their baton
just a tiny bit ahead!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The showdown between Сайленс Судзука,
the
Otherworldly Front-Runner, and Air
Groove, the
Empress, is on!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Fly, Сайленс Судзука! You can do it!
text_block_list.name: Fan A

text_block_list.text: You've got this! You've got this!
text_block_list.name: Fan B

text_block_list.text:
(...All this enthusiastic cheering... It's like
I'm
running at a racecourse.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(I... I want to see what lies beyond this
passion!)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: ...Hah!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: The crowd goes wild.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука does it! She flies across
the finish
line and takes it for the white
team!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Yes. It felt like we were at a racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
The sounds... The atmosphere... The
vibrations!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I went beyond the passion of the crowd
and
found a calm place all my own...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Though, I wish I could have better
expressed my
appreciation for my fans.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: Just show it through your racing.

text_block_list.text: My racing?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: It's exactly what they want to see.

text_block_list.text: Hehe, is that right? In that case...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to keep doing what I do
best.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It seems the events of today's Fan Fest
have
given Сайленс Судзука a motivation
boost.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems the events of today's Fan Fest
have
given Сайленс Судзука a motivation
boost.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
